walkthrough: Compare structural changes and full code

singleton.title: Are these the same object?
singleton.instruction: Retrieve settings for the cart and job, then change a shared flag.

labels.same: Both references point to the same object

singleton.explanation: More retrievals do not create more instances; both entries read the same state.

factory-method.title: Change the product, keep the workflow
factory-method.instruction: Choose a creator and send a message. Watch which step changes.
factory-method.explanation: The factory method returns a different product; the common workflow is reused.

abstract-factory.title: Replace a whole product family
abstract-factory.instruction: Switch factories and watch both widgets change together.
abstract-factory.explanation: One factory choice supplies a compatible family, not independently selected widgets.

builder.title: Build an export job
builder.instruction: Choose options and build. Later configuration edits leave the built result intact.
builder.explanation: The builder holds configuration; build delivers an independent result. Chaining is not the key.

prototype.title: Does editing the copy change the template?
prototype.instruction: Try a shallow copy or prototype clone, then edit the copy's tags.

controls.edit: Add a tag to the copy

prototype.explanation: A shallow copy shares nested references; clone duplicates the tag list that must be independent.

adapter.title: Follow the amount conversion
adapter.instruction: Change the app amount and watch the adapter convert it to SDK cents.
adapter.explanation: Conversion stays at the boundary; the caller need not know SDK units.

bridge.title: Combine two independent dimensions
bridge.instruction: Choose message form and transport independently to try all four combinations.
bridge.explanation: Message form and transport evolve independently without a class for every combination.

composite.title: Nest a bundle and keep totaling
composite.instruction: Add an item or wrap the current bundle in another bundle.
composite.explanation: Leaves return prices; composites sum children. The caller always uses total.

decorator.title: Layer toppings
decorator.instruction: Add milk and sugar and watch the wrapper order and price.
decorator.explanation: Each wrapper keeps the interface, delegates inward and adds its responsibility.

facade.title: One startup entry, three subsystems
facade.instruction: Start through the facade and watch ordered coordination.
facade.explanation: One entry coordinates subsystems for the caller; the subsystems still exist.

flyweight.title: Plant trees, reuse types
flyweight.instruction: Select a species and plant trees; compare instance count with type count.
flyweight.explanation: Positions belong to individual trees; matching trees share intrinsic type data.

proxy.title: Create now, load on display
proxy.instruction: Create the proxy, then display repeatedly and watch actual load count.
proxy.explanation: The proxy controls construction timing; repeated displays cause one load.

chain-of-responsibility.title: Who handles this ticket?
chain-of-responsibility.instruction: Choose an amount and submit at the head. Requests beyond all limits must be unhandled.
chain-of-responsibility.explanation: The first capable handler accepts the request; later handlers are not called.

command.title: Execute, then undo
command.instruction: Turn input into an insertion command and inspect text and history.
command.explanation: A command retains its request and undo state; history restores the prior text.

interpreter.title: Eligible for the offer?
interpreter.instruction: Change age and membership and watch both leaves and AND evaluate.
interpreter.explanation: Terminals read context; AND combines children recursively. This is a manually constructed AST.

iterator.title: Walk a playlist one item at a time
iterator.instruction: Choose direction and fetch one item at a time. The collection does not change.
iterator.explanation: Traversal order and cursor belong to the iterator, not a caller's index loop.

mediator.title: One event coordinates two controls
mediator.instruction: Type a query, then clear it and inspect coordination events.
mediator.explanation: Widgets report events; the mediator updates others without direct widget calls.

memento.title: Save a moment and restore it
memento.instruction: Edit and save a snapshot, continue editing, then choose a snapshot to restore.
memento.explanation: A snapshot stores state, not actions, and retains its text and cursor.

observer.title: Subscribers receive notifications
observer.instruction: Select subscribers and change stock; unsubscribed listeners must stop receiving events.
observer.explanation: The publisher visits current subscribers. Unsubscribing stops future events, not past records.

state.title: Same button, different state
state.instruction: Click the player: start from stopped, pause while playing, resume from paused.
state.explanation: The current state determines both behavior and the next transition.

template-method.title: Replace a step, keep the skeleton
template-method.instruction: Choose an input format; read and save stay fixed while transformation changes.
template-method.explanation: A subclass replaces transformation; the base owns the read-transform-save order.

visitor.title: One tree, two visiting operations
visitor.instruction: Switch between size and name export without changing the element structure.
visitor.explanation: accept dispatches concrete elements to a visitor; a new operation does not edit every node.
